note: Cases of test_kydispatch.py (packet KV3-B-KYDISPATCH v1). $RUN $ROOT $REPO $FLEET $SCRATCH $WT are the world's paths, $CTL the controller a --dry reads the run directory as, $HEAD the synthetic repository head reply, $Ha…$Hf 40-hex heads. `dry` and `ticks` are the checked-in job lists: [{kind, item, pool, decision}] in order.

cases.name: build_job_that_blocks_its_item_ends_blocked
cases.note: the fixture tracker goes on showing K-1 ready, so the engine intends it again: the tracker's `blocked` row is what ends that

cases.name: item_detector_success_is_not_a_verified_step
cases.note: Actual server.py /api/verify returns an item detector with no step identity. STEP remains unknown until its producer supports a named step detector; no invented step response earns done.

cases.name: step_is_never_taken_on_an_unverified_detector
cases.note: Actual producer returns an item detector (pending/done) or 404. None is evidence for the requested step.

cases.name: verify_of_a_registered_green_head_runs_and_publishes
cases.note: under HOLD_MERGES the accepted head is parked, never submitted, and the campaign checkout is not fast-forwarded

cases.name: rework_follows_a_rejected_head
cases.note: escalation BLOCK turns the REWORK into the script job that runs ky block

cases.name: artifact_registration_gets_an_independent_reviewer
cases.note: the author's slot (v1) is never the reviewer's: with only v1 ready the job waits for a slot

cases.name: an_acceptance_is_inherited_only_through_the_shared_predicate
cases.note: exit 1 (a substantive resolution) → the new head is reviewed; exit 0 → it inherits and may merge; any other exit is unknown → neither; a PR head that is not the registered head is never submitted (the head-match guard)

cases.name: a_head_that_moved_after_queueing_is_cancelled_and_its_acceptance_invalidated
cases.note: a cancel submits nothing, so HOLD_MERGES does not park it

cases.name: regen_of_a_conflict_confined_to_generated_outputs
cases.note: kyregen.sh's own exit decides: an exit it does not name is refused; the item lock is free afterwards

cases.name: a_hard_stop_decision_is_notified_at_its_own_level
cases.note: the item stays open for the owner; no second SURROGATE job is launched on unchanged evidence

cases.name: plan_at_a_repacket_request_and_at_the_wave_boundary
cases.note: A boundary PLAN intent while K-1 is blocked is not a detector of wave completion.

cases.name: global_hold_admits_nothing_bootstrap_included
cases.note: the live tick ends at the hold; --dry still shows what waits behind it

cases.name: a_worktree_above_the_ceiling_is_refused
cases.note: limits.copies = 16: a seventeenth own copy is refused; the condition is announced once, not every tick

cases.name: pool_sizes_come_from_the_pool_files
cases.note: absent → 6 builders; unreadable → none; ready work above the maximum raises ONE owner-wait for the surrogate

cases.name: a_snapshot_fallback_of_ky_next_admits_nothing
cases.note: the snapshot fallback carries no version: nothing is derived from it and nothing is admitted on top of it

events.detail: something the tracker has not read yet

cases.name: an_unknown_pull_request_or_event_log_intends_nothing

mutate.events_raw: this line is not an event

cases.note: gh has no answer for PR 7 → unknown, not `no PR`; an event line that cannot be read may be anybody's review

cases.name: a_job_whose_process_is_gone_is_interrupted_and_requeued_once
cases.note: each session is a new controller: the earlier one's slot database is another session's, so the next slot is provisioned

cases.name: a_job_that_still_runs_is_adopted_not_restarted
cases.note: a stop with a job live keeps the instance lock: the next controller takes it over and adopts the job

cases.name: a_refusal_after_open_closes_the_job_refused_and_frees_the_slot
cases.note: K-1's worktree path exists and is no registered worktree: kyd_admit.admit refuses after kyd_jobs.open claimed; the claim is released and K-2 gets the same slot in the same tick. Two intents needed a slot database in the first tick and one was provisioned (one slot a tick)

cases.name: a_subscription_refusal_backs_off_and_resumes
cases.note: 5 → 10 → 20 → 30 min; a quota refusal is never counted as a failure of the item, and a model job that ends without one resets the backoff

cases.name: owner_commands_are_applied_in_order_by_the_lock_holder
cases.note: `loops stop dispatcher` ends the tick it is applied in; the next start finds STOP_dispatcher and exits 0

cases.name: a_tick_that_raises_is_caught_and_journalled
cases.note: Aggregate jobs-directory failure is fatal; individual foreign or unreadable job folders are quarantined in memory.
